game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ash bricks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Sort falling ash bricks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the fire shrine using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the fire shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 16.
